From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@quantivahealth.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Credit warehousing proposal & drawdown cadence

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Quantiva's legal and finance teams asked me to propose a firm approach for the annual prepay drawdown so we can close the agreement this month. Attached is our initial idea for a "credit warehousing" approach (QH_credit_warehousing_proposal_v1.xlsx). High level: Quantiva would pre-fund an upfront amount to an escrow/warehoused balance, and Redwood would pull monthly drawdowns against that balance to cover invoices.

Questions we need answered before sign-off:
- Can Redwood issue monthly invoices that net to the drawdown amount (we need VAT broken out on each invoice)?
- For EU-sourced spend, which Redwood legal entity will issue the invoice and how will VAT be applied?
- We'll need a sample invoice showing the initial upfront charge, the VAT calculation, and the monthly pull amounts.
- Any platform-side flags we need to enable (PO number mapping, ledger account id) to make GL reconciliation trivial.

We can be flexible on cadence (monthly vs. 4-week draws) but want a clear timetable and a short checklist for collections. Can you send a proposed timetable and sample invoice before the end of next week?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m call if easier.

Alex Turner
Head of Finance, Quantiva Health
alex.turner@quantivahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: QH_credit_warehousing_proposal_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Credit warehousing proposal & drawdown cadence

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear brief and the attachment. Attached is a short playbook that outlines how we typically handle credit warehousing + a proposed drawdown table tuned to the numbers in your sheet (redwood_warehousing_playbook.pdf, QH_proposed_drawdown_table.csv).

Key points upfront:
- Billing entity & VAT: For Quantiva EU spend we can invoice from Redwood EU Services B.V. (VAT NL: NL123456789B01). For US and non-EU entities we invoice from Redwood, Inc. This lets us present VAT-bearing invoices where required and apply reverse-charge when appropriate.
- Initial invoice: We issue an initial invoice for the committed prepay on contract effective date. That invoice includes VAT where applicable and will be marked as "credited" against the warehoused balance so your AR can match it to the PO.
- Drawdown cadence: Proposed approach is monthly pulls on the 1st of each month. First pull occurs 30 days after contract start (unless you prefer immediate monthly pull). We can also support a 28-day cadence if your finance team prefers alignment with payroll cycles.
- Reconciliation: Monthly drawdown report (CSV) delivered by the 3rd business day after pull, including token/route-level chargebacks and VAT amounts.

Action items for Quantiva to confirm:
1) Preferred cadence (monthly / 28-day / custom).
2) Billing PO number and billing address for the entity that will receive the invoice.
3) Whether the initial wire will be to Redwood escrow account or to our platform bank account (if to escrow, we will coordinate the escrow account wiring instructions).

If that looks good I'll produce a sample initial invoice (INV-000789_QH_initial.pdf) and the first-month drawdown schedule.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Manager, Business Ops — Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0112

Attachments: redwood_warehousing_playbook.pdf (pdf), QH_proposed_drawdown_table.csv (csv)

- Recommend we insist on Redwood EU Services B.V. for all customer invoicing that flows to EU-sourced billing addresses. This reduces VAT complexity and speeds up reclaim for them.

- Risk: if escrow is used, ensure the escrow agreement states Redwood cannot pull funds beyond the committed monthly amounts. Get legal to signoff on the escrow drawdown clause.

I'll prepare the template language for the invoice footer (VAT reg, remit instructions, Warehoused Credit ID) and loop in Legal if Quantiva asks for escrow contract language.
